name: PROPHETIC 6
author: swtdr34mz
summary: A Prophet-6-style 7-voice analogue poly: two oscillators with sub, noise, sync and poly mod, a high-pass into a resonant 4-pole low-pass, two LFOs, distortion, chorus, delay, five reverbs, an arp on the MPC tempo and a low split. HIGH and ECO quality for the CPU. Panel-style touch pages.
